title: ceropteris calomelanos
intro: Ceropteris calomelanos, commonly known as the Black Fern, is a species of plant in the family Dryopteridaceae, which is a type of fern. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower inflammation, improve respiratory health, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Ceropteris calomelanos include its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
